The '''Core District''' of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Cinnagar/Legends|Cinnagar]] was a city district containing a seemingly endless number of high-end retailers, restaurants, boutiques, and museums on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]].

==Description==
The Core District was the most upscale part of the city of Cinnagar. Bordering the [[Royal District/Legends|Royal District]], the businesses within the district were owned by the planet's working-class who sought to share the culture of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] with the city's populace. The architecture within the district was varied and diverse, representing the classical architecture from across the galactic core. The Core District represented the center of culture within the Core region of the galaxy.<ref name="NoP" />
